coordinate_decomposition.centroid: For each coordinate c, zbar_c=(mean_l HiLLiPoP_lc-mean_l CamSpec_lc)/scale_c. Centroid coordinate share is zbar_c^2 divided by sum over coordinates.
coordinate_decomposition.matched_location: For each matched label l and coordinate c, z_lc=(HiLLiPoP_lc-CamSpec_lc)/scale_c. Coordinate energy is z_lc^2. Pooled matched share is sum_l z_lc^2 divided by sum over all labels and coordinates.
coordinate_decomposition.pairwise_shape: For each canonical label pair a<b, u_Ic=(theta_I,a,c-theta_I,b,c)/scale_c and d_I=sqrt(mean_c u_Ic^2). Signed exact coordinate contribution to d_H-d_C is g_c=(u_Hc^2-u_Cc^2)/(7*(d_H+d_C)); sum_c g_c=d_H-d_C. Localization mass uses |g_c|, preserving cancellation information separately.
coordinate_decomposition.pairwise_shape_zero_denominator_rule: If d_H+d_C is numerically zero, all signed contributions are zero; any nonzero scalar drift in that case is a technical failure.

localization_rule.classification_inconclusive: Required endpoint identity, Q037 replay, frozen scales, exact decomposition, preregistered thresholds, or finite subset captures cannot be validated.
localization_rule.leave_one_label_out_definition: Omit one provenance label at a time; matched uses remaining 8 matched pairs, centroid uses remaining 8 endpoints per implementation, pairwise shape uses the 28 internal pairs not involving the omitted label.
localization_rule.minimal_subset_rule: Choose the smallest cardinality among all qualifying subsets; retain every qualifying subset at that minimum size.
localization_rule.qualifying_subset_rule: A subset qualifies only if it captures at least 0.80 of full-sample mass in matched, centroid, and pairwise-shape channels, and independently reaches at least 0.70 in at least 8 of 9 leave-one-label-out replicates for each channel.
localization_rule.tie_handling: All minimal qualifying subsets are reported; coordinate order is used only for deterministic serialization, never to choose a scientific winner.

scientific_question: Når Q037's paired CamSpec- og HiLLiPoP exact-common-support endpoints analyseres coordinate-by-coordinate under de samme syv Q031 locked scales, er den overlevende implementation geometry difference koncentreret i en reproducerbar minimal subset af common coordinates, eller er den distribueret over flere coordinates?
